name: Book: Stresses of Iron
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Margulf Blaggon’s book on metallurgy is away at Northshire Abbey for copying.

sections.title: A Borrowed Volume
sections.body: Margulf Blaggon wrote about metallurgy in practice and in theory. Milton Sheaf cared for the volume in the Royal Library of Stormwind Keep. The library lent it to Northshire Abbey, where Brother Paxton copied it by hand for his own collection. The work took far longer than expected. So Brother Kristoff waited anxiously in Cathedral Square for the book to return to the city.

faq.answer: Margulf Blaggon’s book covers metallurgy and metalworking in theory and practice.

faq.q: Why was the book at Northshire Abbey?
faq.answer: Brother Paxton borrowed the book from Stormwind’s Royal Library to copy by hand for his own collection. He was to return the original afterward.
Brother Kristoff wanted the book returned. He waited in Cathedral Square and asked urgently for it. An adventurer traced its whereabouts between the Royal Library and Northshire.

angles.text: Margulf Blaggon’s book explores iron’s strengths and the practical limits of working with it.
